production.visual_author: Claude, HyperFrames (HTML and GSAP rendered in Chrome)
production.principle: Original product interface pixels are scaled, cropped and moved; campaign type and motion sit around them. No on-screen provenance labels; qualifications live here and beside the film.

qualification: University team project with institutional sign-in. The film uses demo-data screens of released components, with no real students, plus a privacy-reviewed production syllabus crop, all captured in October 2026. The teacher reviews a question and its score policy before publishing; the film does not show questions being generated.
